name: Assessment
description: Owns reusable assessment instruments, attempts, submissions, marking, moderation, appeals and authoritative assessment-result revisions; does not award qualifications or determine training completion.

provides.description: Validate and govern instrument and rubric revisions.
Evaluate applicable eligibility and control attempt lifecycle.
Accept or quarantine assessment submissions and evidence references.
Record marking, moderation, release and finality decisions.
Maintain attributable appeal, reassessment and correction lineage.
Independently accept or reject external assessment evidence using qualified trust inputs.
Supply authorised result snapshots, provenance and finality.
Supply scoped historical views and export evidence.
Publish committed instrument, attempt, result, appeal, correction and reliance changes.

relationships.rationale: Conditional outcome/rubric alignment; independent examinations need no Course package.

Qualification independently recognises evidence and makes award decisions.
Credentials represents authorised source claims; a pass does not automatically authorise issuance.
Qualified issuer trust is input to Assessment's independent evidence acceptance.
